dict.string: Life Portal Health v2. Start from Life Portal. The supplied Health-only ticket expires after 15 minutes. No account password, permanent token or server URL is embedded. One run processes up to 12 windows; unfinished work stays queued on the server.
Request the next pending interval. Never invent the next hour locally: the server may return a smaller window or resume an interrupted upload.
Health query processing stopped. Return to Life Portal for sync status and any remaining windows.
Serialize each Active Calories sample with source, absolute start/end time, displayed value and unit. Repeat Item refers to the inner Health Samples loop.
Serialize each Steps sample with source, absolute start/end time, displayed value and unit. Repeat Item refers to the inner Health Samples loop.

Upload counts and the array for exactly this window. A capped result is split and re-fetched, not marked complete. The next iteration requests the authoritative server cursor. Failed writes or a lost response leave the pending window safe to retry.
Health batch run finished. Remaining query windows, if any, resume on the next sync. Query completion does not prove complete device wear or permissions.
